The '''Mission to Nar Shaddaa''' was a military operation conducted by the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]]. Its primary task was to shut down an illegal assassin [[Nar Shaddaa droid factory|droid factory]] commissioned by [[Lannik Racto]]. Racto sold these assassin droids on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] to criminal activities.

Lannik Racto had been captured by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]], in a [[Second mission to Coruscant (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|daring mission]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Following his arrest, Racto revealed the site of his factory on Nar Shaddaa and a team of NRI agents were sent to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to shut it down. The agents infiltrated the facility and successfully completed their mission.
